lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe2Co2Si12 (FeCoSi6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Co centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 Si neighbors, Fe centers with 8 Si neighbors, and Si centers with 10 neighbors (4 Co, 6 Si). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Si 10-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Co 12-vertex and Fe 8-vertex polyhedra share corners and faces.
